skill.name: Image Component Optimization
skill.description: Apply Next.js Image component to optimize images through lazy loading and automatic device-based resizing. Use when rendering images in web applications to reduce load time and improve performance.
skill.skill_body: Use the Next.js Image component instead of native tags. The component automatically handles lazy loading and resizes images based on device viewport size. This reduces initial page load and improves rendering performance. ## Objective optimize image delivery and rendering ## Applicable Signals - image rendering required in component - performance optimization goal stated - responsive design requirement present ## Contraindications - using static HTML img tags without optimization requirements - image optimization already handled by CDN or external service - static asset serving without dynamic resizing ## Workflow Steps - Replace native element with Next.js Image component - Configure lazy loading behavior (default: enabled) - Specify or allow automatic device-based image resizing - Verify images load and resize correctly across target devices ## Constraints - Image component must be imported from next/image - Device viewport information must be available at render time - Image dimensions should be specified or inferred ## Cautions - Lazy loading may delay initial image visibility; consider above-the-fold images - Automatic resizing requires browser support for responsive images ## Output Contract - Images load lazily and automatically resize based on device viewport; page performance metrics improve (reduced initial load time, optimized image delivery)
contraindications: using static HTML img tags without optimization requirements
